QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Lingering Embers
QuestInfo.0: After Baldrix and the Knights of the Einherjar withdrew from Tallahart, a new phantom--the priest #bAoe#k--appeared. Speak with him.
QuestInfo.1: Aoe is uneasy about Baldrix's magic lingering in Noctis's sanctum. He asks you to handle it, as you already have experience dealing with Baldrix. Go investigate the #bPhantasmal Night Sanctum#k.
QuestInfo.2: The World Heart reacted to the traces of Baldrix's magic. If you were to focus your mind on the World Heart, maybe you could absorb them.

default.0: Have you been to the sanctum yet?
